name: 1 · Supplier invoices: check → approve → payment file

parameters.content:
## 1 · Supplier invoices: check → approve → payment file
The agent reads each invoice, matches it to its contract and delivery docket, and runs seven checks: contract, price, volume, docket, GST, duplicate and bank account.
A person approves every invoice (the owner decides anything over the limit and everything flagged). The agent then prepares one payment file. A person uploads it to the bank.
In a live business, "Load data" and the update nodes talk to Xero, your inbox and your document store.

### Run from the demo console
The console sends run = check or payments.

### Weekdays 07:30 NZ: check new invoices
Matches each invoice to its contract and docket, runs the seven checks, and sends each approver one list, not one message per invoice.

### 18th of each month 09:00 NZ: prepare the payment file
Approved invoices due by the next pay date go into one bank file. Always the bank account on file. The agent has no bank access: a person uploads the file.

### Approver opens their list
The link in the text or email. It lists only the invoices that person decides.

### Approver opens one invoice
Every check the agent ran, in plain words, and the decision buttons. Flagged invoices put "ask the supplier" first.

### Approver decides
Approve, approve anyway (a written reason is required), ask the supplier (the agent drafted the message; sending needs the click), or reject. Every decision is logged with a name.

### View the invoice as received
Opens a copy of the invoice record, laid out like a tax invoice.

### Add an invoice by hand (demo)
The form, with examples that each break one rule. In your business invoices are read from the invoice inbox.

### Save the invoice
Stored as "new, not checked yet". Checking is a separate step, so you can see it happen.

### Download a payment file
Only exact payment file names are accepted.

meta.description: Reads each supplier invoice, matches it to its contract and delivery docket, runs seven checks, asks the right person to decide, and prepares the payment file. It never approves or pays anything.
